Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Square × Trader Champions League S2: Share Strategies, Split 50,000 USDT & Win 10 GT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Gate Trader Champions League · Season 2 is underway. Lead traders are competing in the Futures and CFD divisions for a main event prize pool of up to 500,000 USDT. Eligible new copiers can also visit the main event page to claim 20 USDT in Copy Trading Trial Funds.
Alongside the competition, Gate Square invites lead traders and copiers to share their trading strategies and experiences. Competing lead traders can post trading plans and trade recaps, while copiers can share their own strategies, explain how they choose lead traders, or discuss their copy trading experiences.
Join the Gate Square event for a share of the 50,000 USDT prize pool. The first 2,000 registrants can receive a sign-up reward, while selected lead traders can earn a 30-day Gate Square Traffic Boost and official features. Register for the Square event and complete at least one copy trade during the event period for a chance to become the Lucky Copier and win the full 10 GT.
## Event Time: November 23, 2026, 02:00 – December 6, 2026, 14:00 (UTC)
Event hashtag: #GateSquareCopyTrading
## Reward 1: First 2,000 Registrants Get a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Registration is open to all users. The first 2,000 users to register successfully for the Gate Square event will each receive a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher. Rewards are allocated in order of successful registration, with one voucher per user.
## Reward 2: Share Your Trading Strategy or Copy Trading Experience for a Chance to Win 5 USDT Daily
Lead traders, copiers, and anyone following the markets are welcome to join. Register for the Square event, then publish an original post with #GateSquareCopyTrading about your trading plan, market outlook, a trade you reviewed, or your copy trading experience. Each qualifying post puts you in the running for a daily award and counts toward your weekly posting days.
## What could you share?
A lead trader you’re watching. Who has caught your attention lately? What made you follow them, or what skill do you value most in a lead trader?
A trade you’d copy or sit out. If a lead trader adds to a position in a volatile market, would you copy the trade or wait? Pick a move that stood out to you and explain what you would do.
Your own trading plan. Think of a recent trade or an opportunity you’re watching. What prompted you to enter, adjust your position, or stay on the sidelines?
How a trade played out. Whether you made a profit or took a loss, did the trade go as expected? If you shared your plan earlier, post an update on whether you followed it and why.
Award | How to qualify | Reward per winner
Daily Top Post | Publish at least 1 qualifying original post that day. Three creators are selected daily | 5 USDT
Weekly Posting Reward | Post on 7 qualifying days that week | 100 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Weekly Posting Reward | Post on 5 qualifying days that week | 50 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Weekly Posting Reward | Post on 3 qualifying days that week | 30 USDT Futures Position Voucher
Weekly Posting Reward | Post on 2 qualifying days that week | 20 USDT Futures Position Voucher
## How posting rewards are calculated
Double rewards for first-time creators. If your first-ever Gate Square post is a qualifying post published with the event hashtag after registration, you qualify for double posting rewards. A Daily Top Post earns 10 USDT, and each weekly voucher tier doubles, up to a 200 USDT Futures Position Voucher per week.
Daily Top Post. Gate Square selects 3 creators each day based on the views they share, the reasoning behind them, and their firsthand experience. Each winner receives 5 USDT before any first-time creator bonus.
Weekly Posting Reward. Qualifying days are counted separately each week and can be nonconsecutive. Multiple qualifying posts on the same event day count as one day. You receive the highest weekly tier you reach and can also earn a Daily Top Post award. The total face value of vouchers available each week is capped at 10,000 USDT. Vouchers are allocated in the order participants reach their respective tiers, until the weekly pool runs out. Your qualification time is the publication time of your first qualifying post on the day you reach that tier.
## Reward 3: One Lucky Copier Wins 10 GT
Register for the Gate Square event and complete at least 1 copy trade after registration and before the event ends to enter the draw.
After the event, Gate Square will randomly select 1 Lucky Copier from all eligible users to receive the full 10 GT. Each user receives one entry for the entire event.
## Reward 4: Lead Traders Can Earn an Official Feature and 30 Days of Additional Visibility
Lead traders competing in the Futures or CFD division of Trader Champions League · Season 2 can register for the Square event and publish 1 original trading post with #GateSquareCopyTrading. Share an opportunity you’re watching, explain why you adjusted a position, or review a completed trade. If market conditions change, you’re welcome to follow up with an updated view.
Daily editorial feature: Gate Square reviews original posts from lead traders each day for its official series, Trader Champions League S2: Lead Trader Strategy Picks. Each feature highlights the trader’s strategy and links to both the original post and their lead trader profile, so readers can explore their reasoning and follow future updates.
30-day visibility boost: Gate Square will hold multiple selection rounds throughout the event, choosing 10 outstanding lead traders per round based on content originality, clarity of strategy, and practical trading value. All selected traders will receive a 30-day Gate Square Traffic Boost.
## Event Rules
Registration. Click [Register Now] on the Gate Square event page. If you have already registered for the main Trader Champions League · Season 2 event, you still need to register separately for the Square event. Once registered, you can participate in each reward you qualify for.
Sign-up reward. The first 2,000 successful registrants each receive a 10 USDT Futures Position Voucher, limited to one per UID. Registration for the other rewards remains open after all sign-up vouchers have been claimed.
Qualifying posts. Posts for Rewards 2 and 4 must be published after successful registration for the Gate Square event and before the event ends, with #GateSquareCopyTrading included at the time of publication. Posts with the hashtag added later will not be counted.
Original content. Posts must include your own views, reasoning, or firsthand experience. Copied announcements, plagiarized or reposted content, repetitive spam posts, fabricated trading records, and screenshots without personal commentary will not qualify.
Posting rewards. One qualifying original post is enough to enter that day’s selection. Gate Square selects 3 creators daily, each receiving 5 USDT. Weekly posting rewards are based on distinct qualifying days, which can be nonconsecutive. Multiple qualifying posts on the same day count once. Posting on 2, 3, 5, or 7 days qualifies you for a 20, 30, 50, or 100 USDT Futures Position Voucher, respectively. Each week is counted separately. You receive the highest tier you reach that week and may also receive a Daily Top Post award.
Lucky Copier draw. Complete at least 1 copy trade after registering for the Square event and before it ends. No post or screenshot is required. Eligibility is determined by the platform’s trade records. Each UID receives one entry for the entire event, regardless of how many copy trades are completed. After the event, one winner will be drawn at random to receive 10 GT.
Lead trader features and visibility boosts. Reward 4 is open to lead traders competing in this season’s Futures or CFD division. Gate Square reviews submissions daily for its editorial series. The 30-day visibility boost is awarded separately in batches of 10 lead traders. Gate Square will contact selected traders directly. The 30-day period begins when the boost takes effect.
Reward distribution and voucher terms. Gate Square will distribute rewards within 14 business days after the event ends. Please check your Futures Position Voucher when you receive it for eligible uses, redemption instructions, and its expiry date.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Celebrate Black Friday & Cyber Monday with Gate Live from November 23–30. Grab up to 500 USDT in Red Packet Rain, earn double points as a streamer, and enjoy exclusive viewer rewards.
Join Now
## Campaign Period: November 23, 2026, 02:00 – November 30, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
## Benefit 1: Red Packet Rain | Up to 500 USDT in Rewards
Join Gate Live at the following times to grab your share of the Red Packet Rain.
Date | Time (UTC)
November 23 – Campaign Kickoff | 12:00
November 26 – Thanksgiving | 12:00
November 27 – Black Friday | 12:00
November 30 – Cyber Monday | 12:00
## Red Packet Rain Reward Tiers
- 1,000 sign-ups: Unlock 100 USDT in Red Packet Rain rewards.
- 3,000 sign-ups: Total rewards increase to 300 USDT.
- 5,000 sign-ups: Unlock the maximum reward pool of 500 USDT.
The more users sign up, the bigger the reward pool. Be sure to join the live room on time and grab your rewards.
## Benefit 2: Streamer Leaderboard | Win Up to 50 USDT
Streamers earn points based on viewership, engagement, and streaming activity. The top 20 streamers will receive rewards.
## Points Breakdown
- Unique qualified viewers: 30%
- Qualified audience engagement: 30%
- Number of valid live streams: 20%
- Number of active streaming days: 20%
Double Points Days
Earn 2x points by going live on November 27 (Black Friday) and November 30 (Cyber Monday).
## Leaderboard Rewards
Ranking | Rewards
TOP 1 | 50 USDT + 3 Homepage Featured Placements
TOP 2 | 30 USDT + 2 Homepage Featured Placements
TOP 3 | 20 USDT + 1 Homepage Featured Placement
TOP 4–10 | Gate Merchandise + 1 Red Packet Rain Support Session
TOP 11–20 | 100 USDT Position Voucher + 7-Day VIP5 Trial
## New Streamer Benefits
- 2x Points: New streamers who join and go live during the campaign earn double points. This bonus cannot be combined with holiday double points. The maximum daily multiplier is 2x.
- Extra Rewards: New streamers can also join the New Streamer Welcome Campaign and earn up to 100 USDT.
## Benefit 3: Viewer Rewards | Watch, Check In & Win
Prizes: Gate merchandise (Thermos, caps, Race Car Building Set, backpacks, etc.), 10/20/50 USDT Futures Trial Fund Vouchers, and 10 USDT cash rewards.
1.Watch & Check In for Guaranteed Rewards
- First-Time Visitors: Users who haven't visited Gate Live in the past 30 days can get a 10 USDT position voucher by watching for 5 minutes and liking or commenting. Limited to one per user. 5,000 USDT prize pool, first come, first served.
- 3-Day Check-In: All users can earn a 20 USDT position voucher by watching for 5 minutes and liking or commenting daily for 3 consecutive days. Limited to one per user.
2.Daily Lucky Draw | Invite Friends for More Entries
- Daily Viewing: Watch for 5 minutes and like or comment to earn 1 entry per day.
- Invite Friends: Invite friends to register and visit Gate Live for the first time. Each successful referral earns you 1 extra entry.
- Unlock More Winners: More qualified new visitors mean more winners.
New Qualified Visitors | Winners
1,000 | 20
3,000 | 50
5,000 | 100
*Note: New visitors must complete the required viewing and engagement tasks. The final number of winners depends on the highest tier reached by the end of the campaign.
## Notes
- All participants need to click the “ Join Now ” button and complete identity verification before the event ends to be eligible for rewards.
- Each valid live stream must last at least 30 minutes to count toward stream and active-day totals.
- A qualified viewer is a unique user who watches for at least 30 seconds. Engagement data is based on platform records.
- Streamers must comply with all related streamer rules during live streaming. Content must be valid; idle streaming, content unrelated to the cryptocurrency industry, or simply playing videos do not meet the requirements of this event. Official staff will evaluate live content, and rewards will be issued only if content is qualified.
- Position Vouchers will be in the form of Futures Position Vouchers (valid for 7 days). Rewards will be distributed to your Gate spot account within 14 business days after the event. Winners will be announced on Gate Live’s official post account and Gate Live’s official X (Twitter) account .
- Rewards will be "airdropped" via the Gate Shop . Users must claim them within the validity period, or they will forfeit the rewards. Once an order is placed, product and shipping details cannot be changed, so ensure all information is correct before submission (If clothing sizes are involved, please carefully confirm the information. You can consult customer service for details. Once shipped, exchanges and returns are not supported.) Incorrect info, refusal, return, or unreachable users will result in forfeiture. Rewards will be sent within 60 days after submitting shipping details. If delivery fails due to logistics, the equivalent Position Voucher will be issued. If the above merchandise is out of stock, it will be replaced with other merchandise of equal value.
- All rewards belong to streamers on Gate Live, and the platform does not take any share. Once the live stream application is approved, users automatically become Gate Live streamers. Apply now.
- Gate will monitor account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the campaign. Prohibited activities include multi-account participation, identity fraud, false verification documents, self-trading, wash trading, fund circulation, reward manipulation, repeated fund transfers, and any other conduct that compromises campaign fairness. Gate reserves the right to disqualify any users found engaging in such activities from receiving rewards.
- Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves all rights to the final explanation.
- This event is not affiliated with Apple Inc. Users in the United Kingdom and other Restricted Locations cannot access the Services (including participation in this event, game or competition). Check the User Agreement for further details on Restricted Locations.
